request.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#v') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #v; IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lslncuocgoi') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lslncuocgoi;
SELECT a.ma_so_thue, a.ma_nvbh, a.ma_tt, a.ma_nh, a.nh_kh1, b.ten_nh [!ten_nh_kh1], a.nh_kh2, c.ten_nh [!ten_nh_kh2], a.nh_kh3, d.ten_nh [!ten_nh_kh3], cast('' as nvarchar(255)) as ma_plkh into #v FROM dmkh0 a left join dmnh b on a.nh_kh1 = b.ma_nh and b.ma_loai_nh ='KH1' left join dmnh c on a.nh_kh2 = c.ma_nh and c.ma_loai_nh = 'KH2' left join dmnh d on a.nh_kh3 = d.ma_nh and d.ma_loai_nh ='KH3'
SELECT ma_so_thue, ma_plkh, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ma_so_thue ORDER BY line DESC) AS RowNum into #lslncuocgoi FROM lslncuocgoi a where exists(select 1 from #v where ma_so_thue = a.ma_so_thue); UPDATE #v set ma_plkh = f.ma_plkh from #v a join #lslncuocgoi f on a.ma_so_thue = f.ma_so_thue
SELECT a.*, b.ten_plkh [!ten_plkh], c.ten_kh [!ten_nvbh], d.ten_tt [!ten_tt], e.ten_nh [!ten_nh] from #v a left join dmploaikh b on a.ma_plkh = b.ma_plkh left join dmkh c on a.ma_nvbh = c.ma_kh and nv_yn = 1 left join dmtt d on a.ma_tt = d.ma_tt left join dmnganhang e on a.ma_nh = e.ma_nh
WHERE a.ma_so_thue = @ma_so_thue

if @action in ('EDIT', 'VIEW') select @script as script drop table #@@table
